title: FileInventoryEntry
description: Metadata for a single file in the repository. Every file gets an inventory entry regardless of whether it contains analysable code. Non-code files (config, assets, docs) carry category and size but no line-level metrics.

fileCategory.description: High-level file category. Adapters map language-specific extensions and paths into these canonical categories.

isAnalyzedLanguage.description: True if this file is in a language the current adapter can extract entities from (e.g. TS/TSX/CSS for the TypeScript adapter).

fileSizeBytes.description: File size in bytes on disk.

totalLines.description: Total number of lines in the file. Null for binary or non-text files.

blankLines.description: Number of blank (whitespace-only) lines. Null for non-text files.

commentLines.description: Number of lines that are comments or documentation. Null for non-text files or when the adapter cannot identify comments.

importExportOnlyLines.description: Number of lines that contain only import/re-export/export-forwarding statements. Null for non-code files.
